data.summary_en: EnactOpt co-evolves reusable textual skills and context-building code, using finite execution feedback to diagnose adjacent decisions, model/runtime unchanged. VLABench, ALFWorld, and Embodied Agent Interface (EAI) show task success rate improving by about 10-27 percentage points over initial harness, outperforming evaluated GEPA, TextGrad, and Trace2Skill baselines.
